TASK.TEXT: The tide rolled in as the moon rose high
over the bay. Small boats bobbed at their
moorings and gulls settled on the rocks.
A soft wind carried the smell of salt.
Out past the reef, a whale broke the water
and blew a tall spout into the night air.
Its tail rose up, dripping silver light,
then slipped below with hardly a splash.
On shore, the divers checked their tanks
and masks for the morning trip. Each one
dreamed of gold coins, old cannons and a
captain's lost compass in the deep sand.
